summary: Verified all 3 major changes for iteration 12: 1) Bullet-free templates, 2) Período e Informações removed from edit screen, 3) Adicionar Subseção button functionality

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated - use 'boxShadow'

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 changes verified working: bullet-free templates in backend, PlainTextArea vs BulletTextArea behavior in frontend, Adicionar Subseção button, removed Período e Informações from edit screen.

feature_1_periodo_e_informacoes_removed.evidence: Edit report screen does NOT show 'Período e Informações' card. No date fields or 'Executado Por' field visible on edit screen. Screenshot confirms: only Foto da Capa, PDF buttons, and sections visible.

feature_2_bullet_free_templates_backend.evidence: Backend API tests confirm: NEW service reports have templates WITHOUT bullet markers (•) in introduction, equipment, objective sections. get_default_service_sections() and get_default_daily_sections() generate clean text.

feature_3_plainTextArea_no_bullet_on_ent.evidence: INTRODUÇÃO textarea uses PlainTextArea. Typed 'Line A' then pressed Enter, typed 'Line B'. Result: 'Line A\nLine B' - NO bullet (•) added. PlainTextArea working correctly.

feature_4_bulletTextArea_adds_bullet_on_.evidence: DESCRIÇÃO DOS SERVIÇOS textarea uses BulletTextArea. Typed 'Service Item 1' then pressed Enter, typed 'Service Item 2'. Result: 'Service Item 1\n• Service Item 2' - bullet (•) ADDED. BulletTextArea working correctly.

feature_5_adicionar_subsecao_button.evidence: 'Adicionar Subseção' button appears at bottom of each expanded section. Clicking shows input field + confirm/cancel icons. Created 'TESTE SUBSEÇÃO' successfully - appeared as '1.1. TESTE SUBSEÇÃO' with its own textarea, photo section, and nested Adicionar Subseção button.

feature_6_sections_modal_checkboxes.evidence: Modal 'Selecionar Seções do Índice' shows all sections with checkboxes. Hierarchical structure displayed correctly: 1 INTRODUÇÃO, 2 EQUIPAMENTOS, 3 OBJETIVO, 4 DESCRIÇÃO DOS SERVIÇOS > 4.1 DESMONTAGEM > 4.1.1 FOTOS, 4.2 MONTAGEM > 4.2.1 FOTOS. Cancelar and Salvar Seleção buttons present.

feature_7_visualizar_pdf_button.evidence: Visualizar PDF (Todos) button present on edit report screen. Backend PDF endpoint returns 200 with application/pdf content-type.

feature_8_salvar_relatorio_button.evidence: Salvar Relatório button present at bottom of edit report screen. Backend update API (PUT /api/reports/{id}) works correctly - tested saving modified sections.
